biological_assembly.selection: Use assembly 1 under its identity operator; retain polymer label asym A/B and exclude water-only label asym C/D.

include: polymer residues in auth chain A
polymer residues in auth chain B
source_filter.altloc_policy: fail unless every selected atom has blank altloc and occupancy 1.0

protonation.basis: validation-local explicit Amber residue assignment; no other titratable residue is renamed

terminal_policy.decision: Treat both complete deposited polymer entities as chemically free, charged N and C termini.
terminal_policy.ownership: This is an explicit SP2016 validation default, not an implicit tleap decision.
terminal_policy.admission_evidence: Require exact LEaP NSER/CSER and NASP/CGLY mappings plus topology H1/H2/H3 and OXT atoms before sealing.

force_field.ion_parameters: Joung-Cheatham monovalent ions loaded by leaprc.water.tip3p

solvation.neutralization: add the minimum counterions before adding equal Na+/Cl- salt pairs

interface.selection: backbone atoms N,CA,C,O of receptor residues within cutoff of any peptide heavy atom
